messages:
Zoey Liu: Hey team, new-hire question — I can see the Eng docs in Notion but most pages are view-only and the 'Duplicate' option is disabled. Who should I ask to get edit rights?
Arun Eng: Welcome Zoey! If Duplicate is disabled it's usually either page block-locks or you only have Org Viewer. The Docs Editors group grants edit/dup rights. @Priya People Ops can add you.
Zoey Liu: thanks — I don't see Docs Editors in my settings. My SSO email is zoey.liu@redwood.ai. Also, is there a single place for templates so I don't accidentally fork a bad canonical runbook?
Priya People Ops: added you to Docs Editors, invite sent. Templates gallery is DevEx templates: https://redwood.notion.site/devex/templates. Canonical runbook template is there. If you need a team variant, duplicate into your workspace first and then open a docs-templates PR to propose it for the org library.
devex-bot: Quick checklist: 1) accept group invite; 2) sign out/in if Notion UI doesn't update; 3) check page for small lock icons on code blocks. For blocked duplicates, ask the page owner to create an unlocked copy.
Zoey Liu: got the invite, accepted, duplicate enabled now. I noticed some mentions like @oncall became plain text after duplicate — any guidance?
Arun Eng: expected behavior. Group mentions referencing org-level groups don't always resolve in the duplicated copy. After duplicating, replace those mentions with the appropriate team group or add a note like "replace @oncall with team rotation link".
Zoey Liu: one more: what's the minimum metadata needed to submit a template PR? I hit a sync error last time.
Priya People Ops: include a top property table with exact keys: template: yes, owner: <team>, visibility: org|team, category: runbook|onboarding|howto, last-reviewed: YYYY-MM-DD. Put it at the very top of the page. If you want a pre-check, drop the Notion link to #devex with "review-request" and a maintainer will scan it before you open the PR.
notion-bot: If you need an editable copy but owners locked command blocks, request a temporary unlocked duplicate from the page owner or export->import as markdown to your workspace.
Zoey Liu: awesome — I'll duplicate the runbook, add team commands, then request a pre-review before filing the PR. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Arun Eng: welcome! tip: add an "Owner" property and a "Last reviewed" date in the header. Makes maintainers happy and prevents sync failures.
